changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwcatalog AS SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.type, c.facility_id, c.department_id, c.appointable, c.parallel_capacity_value, c.default_duration_minutes, c.default_buffer_before_minutes, c.default_buffer_after_minutes FROM public.catalog c;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwcatalog TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwcatalog FROM report_user;
